_about: Mechanism-based family labels, assigned 2026-08-24 from the Phase 11 semantic tuples. Lineage labels stay in each record's `source` string and in papers.txt; this file overrides them when compare.py is run with --families mechanism. Additive: unlisted ids keep their lineage family.

_assignment_basis.pc-neuro: predict@input + error/state objects — predicts sensory input, computes errors, updates neural state. Membership by object, not by spiking
_assignment_basis.pc-learning: correct/train@parameter — predictive coding as a weight-update rule. Includes spiking implementations whose mechanism is a parameter update
_assignment_basis.state-estimation: predict@state / correct@state / filter@state on a dynamical-system state
_assignment_basis.on-policy: evaluate@value + improve@policy/parameter — advantage/surrogate objective on the current policy, no replay buffer. PPO, TRPO, SAC. A3C held out (a3c-outlier)
_assignment_basis.replay-off-policy: store/sample@sample + select/act@action + update@parameter — experience replay loop, target network. DQN, DDPG, TD3, DDQN, Rainbow
